artboards.title: In the app — switch direction above

annotations.text:
The app chrome here is the real thing: 46px title bar, 224px sidebar, the actual nav groups, icons and spacing lifted from the source.

Only the brand tokens change — the tweak above the artboard swaps all five directions in place.

Not up for grabs: the three character colours (sky / amber / orchid) and the status colours. They were picked to stay separable under red-green colour blindness and to mean something inline among data.

The violet reads clearly against all three.
